criteria.criterion: `rebar archive` folds the ticket inline (SNAPSHOT covers all its events) before writing ARCHIVED; a just-archived ticket followed by default `compact-all` carries no unfolded events; checked by the sequence test.

A reverted-archive ticket (stale marker) is never skipped by default; checked by the edge test.
Usage lines and docs/user-guide.md name the new flag on both commands and the archive-time fold; checked by --help output in the test and the doc diff.
